entities.name: Viktor von Schwedler
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viktor von Schwedler was a general in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany who commanded an army corps and a military district during World War II. He was awarded the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross.
